messages:
Naveen: Noticed a surge of GPU evictions in ap-southeast1 this morning, ~03:10-03:25 UTC. Lots of model pods reporting topology affinity failures after warmpool churn.

Naveen: example kube events: `Warning Evicted pod/gpu-model-47 Preempted: node topology mismatch: expected nvlink-group: g1, node labels: nvlink-group: ''`

Clara: Are customers affected or just internal jobs?

Naveen: Two paying Dedicated customers saw brief 5-10m errors (retries fixed). CS paged me.

Ops-Lead: Which automation touched those nodes? Warmpool scaler ran a reclaim at 03:05 UTC. That job removed ephemeral annotations when moving nodes between pools.

Samir: If annotations are dropped we break scheduler's topology packing predicate. Need to avoid moving nvlink-bonded nodes without preserving labels.

Naveen: Warmpool config excerpt: ```yaml
warmpool:
  reclaim: true
  preserve_topology_labels: false
  concurrent_moves: 20
```

Jiayi: preserve_topology_labels:false is the smoking gun. Immediate mitigation: set to true and drop concurrent_moves to 2 for ap-southeast1. Can we patch quickly?

Finance: FYI, cross-AZ egress and reboots added ~$300 extra yesterday in that region while pods rescheduled.

Ops-Lead: I'll patch warmpool config in ap-southeast1 to `preserve_topology_labels: true` and `concurrent_moves: 2` as a hotfix. Deploy-Bot, run canary to ap-southeast1-a first.

Deploy-Bot: hotfix job queued by Ops-Lead: warmpool-preserve-labels -> canary(ap-southeast1-a) -> pause=5m.

Samir: Also scheduling note: we need a simulator test that models label-preservation across node lifecycle ops. Filing ticket to add nvlink label invariants to our pack-sim.

Jiayi: I'll update runbook section "warmpool topology preservation" with rollback steps and add the checklist for canarying.

Naveen: After canary flip: eviction rate dropped to baseline within 8 minutes. Affected customers reported recovery.

Clara: Thanks — I'm sending a brief to CS with timestamps and customer manifests.

Ops-Lead: Action items: 1) keep hotfix for 24h, 2) Samir add simulator invariant, 3) Jiayi update runbook, 4) Miguel (ops) follow up with incident postmortem if any regression.

Deploy-Bot: canary complete, change promoted to region. No failures.

Naveen: tagging @Samir @Jiayi @Clara. Closing unless we see new flaps. :white_check_mark:
